API paths are unchanged because the unmodified native useVehicleAccess hooks (/vehicles/{id}/drivers, /drivers/refresh, DELETE /drivers, /vehicles/{id}/invitations, /invitations/refresh, POST /invitations, /invitations/{invitationId}/revoke) and useVehicle (/vehicles/{id}) are reused. Every t('vehicleAccess.*', 'Default') key + default is kept verbatim through a native key/English-default `t` (react-i18next is not wired on native); no t() call on this page uses interpolation vars.

useParams<{id}>().id has no native router. The `vehicleId` name is preserved: it is sourced from an optional `vehicleId` prop (the route param a navigator passes) and falls back to String(useVehicles()[0].id) so the page renders standalone (the DrivetrainHealthPage native idiom). useVehicle(vehicleId ?? '') is kept verbatim and the web breadcrumbLabels value `vehicle?.display_name ?? `Vehicle #${vehicleId}`` is reproduced as `vehicleLabel` and surfaced as a header caption (native has no breadcrumb slot; the value/expression is preserved). usePageTitle(t('vehicleAccess.title')) drives document.title on web (no RN analogue) so the translated title is surfaced as the on-screen accessibilityRole="header" page title.

PageContainer (title/subtitle + a `loading` gate that swaps the body for a centered Spinner, per web PageContainer L111-114) is reproduced as an inline ScrollView scaffold: a persistent header (page title + subtitle + vehicle caption) and a body that renders the two sections + dialogs only when isLoading is false and otherwise shows a centered ActivityIndicator — matching the web gate exactly (isLoading = driversLoading || invitationsLoading). The two ConfirmDialogs are mounted outside the loading gate (always rendered, visibility driven by open) exactly as the web mounts them after the sections.

DOM/web-UI swaps — no DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, react-router, lucide-react, or old web UI imports: GlassPanel -> native GlassPanel (the drivers data-tour="vehicle-access" becomes testID vehicle-access-drivers); Button primary/ghost sm (lucide RefreshCw/UserPlus, loading spinner, aria-label) -> a native Pressable ActionButton preserving variant/loading/disabled (ActivityIndicator while loading) with glyphs RefreshCw ↻ / UserPlus +; Button ghost iconOnly (lucide UserMinus remove / XCircle revoke) -> IconGhostButton danger-toned Pressables carrying accessibilityLabel t('…remove')/t('…revoke') and glyphs ⊖ / ⊘; CopyButton(ghost,iconOnly,withToast) -> CopyLinkButton, an icon Pressable using the same native-safe navigator.clipboard strategy as the shared MaskedValue (reports 'unavailable' until a clipboard module is bundled) with a ⧉ -> ✓ withToast glyph swap; Badge variant=info (role) -> an accent pill (accentSoft/accent), Badge variant=neutral (counts) -> a gray pill (surfaceRaised/textSecondary); DataTable + Column compact -> a native table (header row + data rows) driven by the SAME column definitions (key/header/render) the web builds in useMemo, preserving every cell renderer, the keyExtractor (row.id) and the w-12 action/link columns (fixed 44px centered cells) — DataTable pagination is not engaged (the source passes no page size and these lists are short, so all rows render, preserving all data); StatusBadge -> InvitationStatusBadge reproducing the web FSM badge-dot colours via getStateDefinition('vehicle', x).badgeDot (online=bg-green-400->success, offline=bg-red-400->danger, asleep=bg-purple-500->violet) + the capitalised status label, with the verbatim pending->online/revoked->offline/else->asleep mapping; TimeStamp value=expires_at format 'auto' -> TimeStampText resolving 'auto' to settings.time_format_default ('relative' fallback, exactly like useTimeFormatPreference) with formatRelative/formatDateTime/formatDate inlined verbatim from @/lib/dateFormat (just now / Nm/Nh/Nd ago, absolute >7d, '—' on nullish/NaN; the web hover tooltip showing the alternate format has no native analogue and is dropped); EmptyState(lucide Users/Shield icon + message) -> an inline icon+message EmptySection (SemanticIcon users/security + the message) because the shared native EmptyState requires a title the web variant does not supply; ConfirmDialog(variant danger, default cancelLabel 'Cancel') -> an inline RN Modal (transparent fade) confirm dialog with backdrop->onCancel close, preserving title/message/confirmLabel/onConfirm/onCancel and the 'Cancel' default; FadeIn and FadeIn delay={0.05} (framer-motion) -> plain Views (the 0.05 stagger delay is dropped). Tailwind text-[var(--text-*)] colours map to theme tokens (textPrimary/textSecondary/textMuted) and the red-400 ghost-icon hover map to the danger token.
